publication_name: Global liquidity indicators, USD credit to non-banks outside the United States
access_description: BIS SDMX REST API v1. No API key. One quarterly series, detail=full. includeHistory is not a parameter.
auth_requirement: No API key. The OpenAPI document describes no security scheme.
conditions: Cite the BIS as the source. Do not imply endorsement or affiliation. If the statistics are used in a commercial publication or product, their inclusion must not result in any additional charge to subscribers or other users. Do not present a translation as an official BIS translation. This row is only Q.USD.3P.N.A.I.B.USD.
revision_behaviour: The SDMX response is the current series, not a historical vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted and are not stored as zero.
unresolved_questions: The permitted-use terms do not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. The current file cannot reconstruct vintages from before they are collected.
evidence_note: The BIS data-portal legal page states: The use of the statistics is unrestricted, provided that if the statistics are reproduced, the BIS must be cited in the publication or product as the source, and if the statistics will be used in a commercial publication or product, their inclusion will not result in any additional charge to subscribers or other users. No other use is permissible. The same page says the BIS provides an API to facilitate access to the statistics. The response title is: USD denominated credit (bank loans & debt securities) to non-bank borrowers located outside the US. UNIT_MEASURE is USD and UNIT_MULT is 6, stored as US dollar, millions, without rescaling the raw value. A non-persisting fetch on 2026-10-24 contained 105 quarterly observations from 2000-Q1 to 2026-Q1, observation status A and confidentiality F, with no gaps. It is not a historical vintage panel. The stored class is latest-revised. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000.
